# Darby Thomas

> Senior product designer, illustrator, and creative based in Berkeley, California. Currently designing at GitHub; previously at Patreon, Parabo Press, and Photojojo.

## Product design and speaking

- [Quirk Up Your Workplace](https://dthoma1.github.io/projects/quirk-up-your-workplace.html): A Config 2026 talk about bringing personality, play, and quirk into the workplace.
- [GitHub Billing](https://dthoma1.github.io/projects/github-billing.html): Product design work involving enterprise billing, cost centers, AI credit budgets, and usage controls.
- [Copilot Search in GitHub Docs](https://dthoma1.github.io/projects/github-docs.html): A product design case study on AI-powered documentation search, from discovery through public preview.
- [GitHub Sponsors](https://dthoma1.github.io/projects/sponsors-onboarding.html): Brand, marketing, landing-page, and onboarding work for GitHub Sponsors.
- [Octocat Keycap](https://dthoma1.github.io/projects/octocat-keycap.html): Industrial and brand design for a custom GitHub Octocat keycap.

## Writing

- [My Favorite Stationery Supplies for 2026](https://dthoma1.github.io/writing/favorite-stationery-supplies-2026.html): The pens, pencils, notebooks, and desk tools Darby uses.
